simple.summary: תְּשֻׁאָה (tᵉshuʼâh) means a crashing or loud clamor First listed occurrence: Isa 22 2.

definitions.full: H8663. teshuah [ תְּשֻׁאָה ] noun feminine noise (properly of devastation, storm); — ᵑ0 only plural תְּשֻׁאוֺת absolute city noises Isa 22:2 (of הוֺמִיָּה עִיר ), adverb accusative = (with) shoutings Zech 4:7 ; so construct ׳ת יִשְׁמָ֑ע לֹא נוֺגֵשׂ Job 39:7 (subject wild ass); ׳ת סֻכָּתוֺ 36:29 (of thunder); read perhaps singular תְּשֻׁוָה (= תְּישׁאָה ) 30:22 Kt, dissolvest me in (or, into ) the roar of the storm (|| make me ride on wind ), so Ew Ol De Di Du Bu and others; > תֻּשִׁיָּה Qr AV my substance (?), Du ׳מִתֻּשׁ 'ohne Halt' (?).
